'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is an elderly NPC who is first seen during {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}. 

{{Dialogue Start}}
==Dialogue==
;During {{Quest|The Wind Before the Storm}}
:'''Wenxi:''' Excuse me, any word about my husband? He left the village yesterday morning, but he still hasn't returned...

:'''Anran:''' I'm sorry, we haven't seen him either...

:'''Anran:''' But we'll let you know the moment there's news.

:'''Wenxi:''' Oh, my darling... Please be safe...
----
;After {{Quest|Xuanling Sings, Storm Quelled}}
:'''Yunzhou:''' Mom! I'm home! Where's dad? I've brought him a souvenir from Mingting!

:'''Wenxi:''' Oh, Yunzhou... My dear boy... Your father... He... he's gone...

:'''Yunzhou:''' W-What do you mean...?

:'''Wenxi:''' Something terrible happened in Xuanfang a while back, and your father left the village that day...

:'''Yunzhou:''' B-But... It can't be...

:'''Yunzhou:''' Dad... How...

:'''Yunzhou:''' That Master [[Lisheng]]'s fan painting you've always wanted... I got it for you...
{{Dialogue End}}
